surveyRegions.interpretation: Deep fine regolith dust blanket, very few surface boulders larger than 1 meter. Ideal for high-speed rover traverses.
Dense blocky crater ejecta. Multiple boulders exceeding rover wheel ground clearance (0.4m). Wheel navigation caution required.
Extremely rocky terrain with jagged basaltic boulders and impact breccia. High hazard of chassis stranding.
